name: @saihm/mcp-server
description: Sovereign, encrypted, sharable, persistent memory protocol MCP server for AI agents. Eight MCP tools forward to a SAIHM operator endpoint that runs the full protocol stack on COTI V2 mainnet.
description_good_justification: README explains: a Model Context Protocol server exposing eight tools that connect any MCP-capable AI agent to a SAIHM operator endpoint running the full sovereign-memory protocol on COTI V2 mainnet.
interact_justification: Public interaction via GitHub Issues at https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/issues. Protocol channel documented at https://saihm.coti.global.
floss_license_justification: Apache-2.0, OSI-approved. LICENSE file at repo root: https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/blob/main/LICENSE.
floss_license_osi_justification: Apache-2.0 is approved by the Open Source Initiative (https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0).
documentation_basics_justification: README covers install (npm/npx), configure (env vars), wiring into Claude Code, security defaults, and the eight-tool surface.
documentation_interface_justification: README documents each of the eight MCP tools (saihm_remember, saihm_recall, saihm_forget, saihm_status, saihm_share, saihm_revoke_share, saihm_governance_propose, saihm_governance_vote) with input/output expectations and security defaults.
sites_https_justification: All project sites use HTTPS: github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp, www.npmjs.com/package/@saihm/mcp-server, saihm.coti.global.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues is the primary discussion channel and supports threaded discussion on issues and pull requests.
english_justification: All project artifacts (README, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, code comments, commit messages) are in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained. v0.1.2 published to npm 2026-05-16; latest commit 2026-05-19. Maintainer responsive (see issues + commit cadence).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: .gitignore excludes all .env* files; no credentials, tokens, or keys are committed. npm publish uses sigstore provenance attestation for distribution integrity.
repo_track_justification: Git on GitHub tracks every change with author, timestamp, and parent commit references.
repo_interim_justification: Work-in-progress is committed to feature branches before merge to main. Main is always releaseable.
repo_distributed_justification: Git is a distributed version control system.
version_unique_justification: npm @saihm/mcp-server@0.1.0 and 0.1.2 are unique semver identifiers; see https://www.npmjs.com/package/@saihm/mcp-server.
release_notes_justification: Release notes captured in tagged commit messages on GitHub: https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/commits/v0.1.2. Major-release commit subject: 'Release v0.1.2: add mcpName, server.json, smithery.yaml'.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly-known vulnerabilities have been disclosed against @saihm/mcp-server to date. The criterion will be applied on first vulnerability-fix release.
report_process_justification: https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/issues for bugs and feature requests. Security issues follow https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md (private channel).
report_responses_justification: Maintainer responds to bug reports within 14 days. SECURITY.md sets a 14-day acknowledgment target for security reports specifically.
enhancement_responses_justification: Maintainer responds to enhancement requests within 14 days. See CONTRIBUTING.md: 'Open an issue first to discuss scope.'
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues (including closed/resolved) are permanently publicly archived and searchable at https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/issues?q=is%3Aissue.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md describes the responsible-disclosure process, scope/out-of-scope, and disclosure timelines.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md publishes the private channel architect@saihm.coti.global. Reports are not handled via the public issue tracker.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to 14-day acknowledgment and 30-day initial assessment / fix-or-mitigation-plan target for confirmed vulnerabilities, depending on severity and complexity.
build_justification: `npm run build` invokes the TypeScript compiler to emit dist/. See package.json scripts and https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/blob/main/tsconfig.json.
build_common_tools_justification: Standard Node.js + TypeScript toolchain (npm + tsc); no exotic or proprietary build dependencies.
build_floss_tools_justification: All build dependencies are FLOSS: TypeScript (Apache-2.0), npm (Artistic-2.0), Node.js (MIT).
test_justification: Integration test at tests/integration.test.ts. Runnable via `npm test`.
test_invocation_justification: `npm test` documented in README and CONTRIBUTING.md; runnable from a fresh clone after `npm install`.
test_most_justification: Integration test exercises tool listing (tools/list) and each of the eight MCP tool-call round-trips against a mock operator endpoint.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md: 'New non-trivial functionality must include a test.' Reviewers enforce this on pull requests.
tests_are_added_justification: Test policy applied throughout v0.1.x. Recent v0.1.2 release added metadata only (mcpName, server.json, smithery.yaml) — no functional code path requiring new tests.
tests_documented_added_justification: Test policy documented in CONTRIBUTING.md ('Pull-request process' section).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions workflow at https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, and `npm test` on every push to main and every pull request, against Node 20.x and 22.x. Workflow runs visible at https://github.com/SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp/actions.
warnings_justification: TypeScript strict mode (`strict: true` in tsconfig.json) reports type-correctness and null-safety warnings on every build.
warnings_fixed_justification: Build passes with zero compiler warnings on every commit to main.
warnings_strict_justification: tsconfig.json sets `"strict": true`, enabling all of strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictFunctionTypes, etc.
know_secure_design_justification: Design uses defense-in-depth: HTTPS-only operator endpoints (plain http:// rejected at construction time except 127.0.0.1/localhost dev exception), per-call 30s abort window, 16MB Content-Length cap, no Authorization-header echo on errors, no filesystem reads, zero EVM tooling. Protocol-layer cryptography references well-published primitives: ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS-204) for post-quantum identity binding; HKDF (RFC 5869) for per-cell key derivation; standard NIST-approved AEAD ciphers for cell encryption.
know_common_errors_justification: Maintainer is familiar with the OWASP Top 10, the broader OWASP API Security Top 10, and the emerging OWASP-MCP / agent-tool risk taxonomy. Server enforces conservative defaults to prevent credential leakage (no header echo on error, no disk reads, no shell execution).
crypto_published_justification: Operator-endpoint protocol uses publicly-published primitives only: ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS-204, 2024), HKDF (RFC 5869, 2010), Ed25519 (RFC 8032, 2017).
crypto_call_justification: MCP server itself implements no cryptography; the operator endpoint runs the full protocol stack. If operators inject signature verifiers via AuthVerifiers, README recommends pure-crypto libraries (@noble/curves, @noble/post-quantum) rather than rolling custom code.
crypto_keylength_justification: ML-DSA-65 is NIST Category 3 (post-quantum); HKDF uses SHA-256; Ed25519 is 256-bit. All meet or exceed NIST 2024+ key-strength recommendations.
crypto_working_justification: No deprecated or broken primitives in use. ML-DSA-65, HKDF, Ed25519 are NIST/IRTF-current recommendations.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No MD5 or SHA-1 used for integrity; no RC4; no DES; no ECB-mode block ciphers. All hashing is SHA-256 or stronger.
crypto_pfs_justification: Per-cell DEK derivation via canonical HKDF (MPS-PQC-KEY-GEN-v1) ensures session-key separation; KEK rotation is versioned, enabling forward secrecy across rotation boundaries.
crypto_password_storage_justification: @saihm/mcp-server stores no passwords. Authentication uses Bearer tokens issued by the operator after key-bound enrolment; the server forwards these without persisting them.
crypto_random_justification: All randomness sourced from Node.js `crypto.randomBytes`, which uses the OS CSPRNG (/dev/urandom on Linux, CryptGenRandom on Windows).
crypto_used_network_justification: MCP server itself does not negotiate cryptography over the network; it forwards already-authenticated requests over HTTPS to a configured operator endpoint. The operator endpoint implements protocol-layer cryptography end-to-end.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distribution via npm registry over HTTPS with sigstore provenance attestation. Server enforces HTTPS-only on operator endpoint URLs (plain http:// rejected at construction except 127.0.0.1/localhost dev exception).
delivery_unsigned_justification: npm publish flow signs releases via sigstore provenance attestation. Users can verify with `npm audit signatures` and `npm view @saihm/mcp-server --json`.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unfixed vulnerabilities in @saihm/mcp-server to date.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known publicly-disclosed critical vulnerabilities in @saihm/mcp-server to date.
static_analysis_justification: TypeScript strict-mode compilation (`tsc --noEmit`) acts as static analysis on every build and via `npm run typecheck`. The package surface is small (single forwarding shim) with no native code, no SQL, no shell-exec — common static-vuln categories are structurally absent.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: TS strict-mode catches null-deref, type-confusion, and unchecked-undefined classes of bug. Server surface is a small forwarding shim; injection / unsafe-eval / shell-exec attack classes are not present in the call graph.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: All static-analysis warnings are fixed before commits land in main; CI build is clean.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every build / commit (`tsc --noEmit` integrated into `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`).
dynamic_analysis_justification: Integration test in tests/integration.test.ts runs the server end-to-end against a mock operator endpoint. Manual smoke-test is required before each npm publish.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: TypeScript on Node.js is a memory-safe runtime; criterion targets memory-unsafe languages (C/C++/Rust-unsafe-blocks/etc.).
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Integration tests run with assertions enabled (Node.js default). TypeScript strict mode prevents many classes of undefined-behavior at compile-time before runtime checks become necessary.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: All issues uncovered by dynamic testing are fixed before commits land in main.
